newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Fahd called on private hospitals to consider reasonable charges for their services.
- The commercial committee of the Arab Air Carrier Organization holds a meeting in Jeddah to discuss compensation guidelines for airlines in case of accidents.
- Clinton is to receive Saudi Arabia's defence minister in Washington on Tuesday.
- The Saudi Arabian Fertiliser Company's shareholders are demanding a 50 percent dividend increase.
- Chevron Saudi Petrochemicals Company is to lay the foundation stone of its industrial complex in Jubail on March 9.
- Around 80 percent of the 32 million riyal Gold Central Market compound in Dammam has been completed.
